issue: Node SSR and Chromium could serialize raw floating-point SVG coordinates differently at approximately 1e-14, producing a React hydration attribute mismatch.

fix.strategy: Serialize every computed SVG coordinate to a fixed three-decimal string before JSX reaches React.
coverage: mobile and desktop x coordinates for truth guides, stems, circles, peak labels, and ticks
mobile and desktop y coordinates for stems, circles, and peak labels
all mobile and desktop polyline path coordinate pairs

next_guidance_applied: Next 16.2 documents hydration as reconciliation of server HTML with the client component tree; the fix makes both renders deterministic instead of hiding the mismatch with suppressHydrationWarning.

required: Load the real lesson in Next dev mode at 360 CSS px in light and dark themes.
Confirm the browser console contains zero hydration mismatch messages.
Confirm no Next issue badge or overlay is present.
Keyboard-run Coarse tone to Q=4, Padded pair, and Long pair and reconfirm their expected PASS/FAIL states.
live_hydration_recheck.claim: No live hydration sign-off is claimed in this artifact.

blockers: Live hydration recheck intentionally deferred to the independent auditor.
